result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example. The existing suite (`mvn -q -o test`) passed, but I ran it before the last edit, which only touched the javadoc.

The change is in `DataStore.countPurchaseOrdersIntoSalesRepRegionsPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, which is the same filter the other per-rep counts use. I also updated the method's javadoc to say cancelled orders are left out.

Ordering and the zero rows for reps without purchase orders are unchanged.
